audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar lampstand and Levite cleansing text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for lampstand lighting, Levite cleansing, wave-presentation, firstborn substitution, service ages, and withdrawal from heavy service. Anti-ageism, anti-shame, and service-without-superiority safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you make lamps go up, toward face/front of lampstand seven lamps shall give light.

familiar.text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

modern.text: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑יו בְּהַעֲלֹֽתְךָ֙ אֶת הַנֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה יָאִ֖ירוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַנֵּרֽוֹת

verses.restored: Aaron did so; toward face/front of lampstand he made its lamps give light, as YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

modern.text: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

original.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַמְּנוֹרָ֔ה הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: This was workmanship of lampstand: hammered work of gold, from its base to its blossom, hammered work; according to pattern YHWH showed Moses, so he made lampstand.

familiar.text: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

modern.text: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses. Cleansing the Levites

original.text: וְזֶ֨ה מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה הַמְּנֹרָה֙ מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד יְרֵכָ֥הּ עַד פִּרְחָ֖הּ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּמַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת הַמְּנֹרָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Take Levites from midst of children of Israel and cleanse them.

familiar.text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

modern.text: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

original.text: קַ֚ח אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְטִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Thus you shall do to them to cleanse them: sprinkle purification water upon them; let them pass razor over all their flesh, wash their garments, and cleanse themselves.

familiar.text: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

modern.text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.

original.text: וְכֹֽה תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְטַֽהֲרָ֔ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְהֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֨עַר֙ עַל כָּל בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִטֶּהָֽרוּ

verses.restored: They shall take one young bull with its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and a second young bull you shall take for sin/purification offering.

familiar.text: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

modern.text: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

original.text: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָ֔ר וּמִנְחָת֔וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן וּפַר שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן בָּקָ֖ר תִּקַּ֥ח לְחַטָּֽאת

verses.restored: You shall bring Levites before tent of meeting and assemble whole congregation of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

modern.text: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת כָּל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: You shall bring Levites before YHWH, and children of Israel shall lay their hands upon Levites.

familiar.text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

modern.text: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.

original.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: Aaron shall wave/present Levites as wave offering before YHWH from children of Israel, and they shall be for serving service of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

modern.text: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.

original.text: וְהֵנִיף֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֤ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Levites shall lay their hands upon heads of bulls; make one as sin/purification offering and one as burnt offering to YHWH, to make atonement/covering for Levites.

familiar.text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

modern.text: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

original.text: וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּרִ֑ים וַ֠עֲשֵׂה אֶת הָאֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְאֶת הָאֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: You shall stand Levites before Aaron and his sons and wave/present them as wave offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.

original.text: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: You shall separate Levites from midst of children of Israel, and Levites shall be mine.

familiar.text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

modern.text: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.

original.text: וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: Afterward Levites shall enter to serve tent of meeting; you shall cleanse them and wave/present them as wave offering.

familiar.text: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

modern.text: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְאַֽחֲרֵי כֵן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְטִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם תְּנוּפָֽה

verses.restored: For given, given they are to me from midst of children of Israel; in place of every one opening womb, every firstborn from children of Israel, I have taken them for myself.

familiar.text: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

modern.text: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.

original.text: כִּי֩ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔י מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תַּחַת֩ פִּטְרַ֨ת כָּל רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי

verses.restored: For mine is every firstborn among children of Israel, among human and among beast; on day I struck every firstborn in land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

familiar.text: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

modern.text: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.

original.text: כִּ֣י לִ֤י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖ם לִֽי

verses.restored: I took Levites in place of every firstborn among children of Israel.

familiar.text: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

modern.text: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.

original.text: וָאֶקַּח֙ אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֥חַת כָּל בְּכ֖וֹר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: I gave Levites as given ones to Aaron and his sons from midst of children of Israel, to serve service of children of Israel in tent of meeting and to make atonement/covering for children of Israel, so no plague shall be among children of Israel when children of Israel draw near to holy place.

familiar.text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

modern.text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”

original.text: וָאֶתְּנָ֨ה אֶת הַלְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֗יו מִתּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַעֲבֹ֞ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּלְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּגֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

familiar.text: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

modern.text: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.

verses.restored: Levites purified themselves from sin/misalignment and washed their garments; Aaron waved/presented them as wave offering before YHWH, and Aaron made atonement/covering for them to cleanse them.

familiar.text: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

modern.text: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.

original.text: וַיִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וַֽיְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּ֨נֶף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְטַהֲרָֽם

familiar.text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

modern.text: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Retirement for Levites

original.text: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵ֞ן בָּ֣אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם לַעֲבֹ֤ד אֶת עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִפְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑יו כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל הַלְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: This is what belongs to Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward he shall enter to serve service in work of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

modern.text: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַלְוִיִּ֑ם מִבֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה יָבוֹא֙ לִצְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: From fifty years old he shall return from host of service and shall serve no longer.

familiar.text: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

modern.text: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.

original.text: וּמִבֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִצְּבָ֣א הָעֲבֹדָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד

verses.restored: He may minister with his brothers in tent of meeting to keep charge, but work/burden he shall not do. Thus you shall do to Levites concerning their charges.

familiar.text: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

modern.text: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”

original.text: וְשֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת אֶחָ֜יו בְּאֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַעֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמִשְׁמְרֹתָֽם

translation_notes: Lampstand light faces inward/frontward, emphasizing ordered illumination before service begins.
Levites are presented by the whole congregation, showing communal participation in their vocation.
Firstborn substitution continues Numbers 3 and is ritual representation, not a hierarchy of human value.
The age boundary concerns physically demanding tabernacle work. At fifty, Levites are not discarded: they continue assisting and keeping charge without heavy burden.
Cleansing language is ritual preparation, not body shame or moral disgust.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 8 to rank clergy above others, shame bodies, or treat older workers as useless. The chapter distinguishes heavy labor from continued experienced service and protects the community through shared, accountable vocation.
